summary: Zebuxoruk’s Cell is the final chamber of his cosmic imprisonment. Here, void pressure, eternity chains, temporal stasis, and null binding converge to hold the Bound One outside time and reality.
history: Forged during the planar war to prevent Zebuxoruk’s ascension.
Temporal stasis fields were created to freeze his influence.
Void core pressure maintains the prison’s metaphysical integrity.
The Bound One remains suspended between existence and nonexistence.
